# Idle

> Passive and offline earnings (idle / tycoon loop).

- Package: `Idle` · Category: Progression & live ops
- Starts at server boot: **yes, whenever installed** (it has work to do before its first call)
- Installing it also installs: [Data](Data.md), [Economy](Economy.md)
- Check it is installed: `GaxiaServer.IsInstalled("Idle")` (server) / `Gaxia.IsInstalled("Idle")` (shared/client keys)

## `GaxiaServer.Idle`

- Runs: **server only (Script / server ModuleScript)**
- Source: `src/ServerStorage/Gaxia_Packages_Server/Lib/IdleService.lua`

Get it:

```lua
local GaxiaServer = require(game:GetService("ServerStorage").Gaxia_Packages_Server)
local Idle = GaxiaServer.Idle
```

### Functions

- `Idle.ComputeOffline(lastSeen: number, now: number, rate: number, maxOffline: number, cap: number): (number, number)`
  ── PURE: clamp elapsed then apply rate + cap (unit-testable) ──
- `Idle.Configure(player: Player, cfg: IdleConfig): ()`
- `Idle.SetRate(player: Player, rate: number): ()`
- `Idle.GetRate(player: Player): number`

- `Idle.Collect(player: Player): (number, number)`
- `Idle.RecordSeen(player: Player): ()`
  Stamp lastSeen = now (e.g. on leave) so offline time is measured from here.

### Signals

Connect with `:Connect(function(...) end)`; the parameters are the payload types, in order.

- `Idle.OnOfflineEarnings` — `Signal<Player, number, number>`
  (player, earnings, seconds) after a Collect that paid > 0; earnings = the amount actually credited (after the pet multiplier), seconds = the clamped offline time
